modmenu.descriptionTranslation.${mod_id}: Client-Side Fabric mod (addon) for PlasmoVoice & SimpleVoiceChat, that scales player heads when they're talking.
talkingheads.modmenu.title: §l Configuration ${mod_name}
talkingheads.option.enableMod.desc: Turns all mod features on or off.
talkingheads.option.removedVolume.desc: How quickly the head decreases after the end of speech.
talkingheads.option.scaleX.desc: Adjusts head size along the horizontal (X) axis.
talkingheads.option.scaleY.desc: Adjusts head size along the vertical (Y) axis.
talkingheads.option.scaleZ.desc: Adjusts the depth of the head along the (Z) axis.
